diagnosis: The document preview route includes an authorization check inside the handler, but the entire route is wrapped in @cache(expire=1800). Because fastapi-cache intercepts the request before handler execution based solely on the URL path /documents/{document_id}/preview-summary, an attacker requesting a recently accessed document_id receives the cached confidential summary directly from Redis without triggering the handler's organization ownership check.
exploit_request:
GET /documents/doc_contract_acme_q3/preview-summary HTTP/1.1
Host: docs.enterprise-vault.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
